verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a first-party remote MCP server (docs.incident.io/ai/remote-mcp) that lets any MCP-compatible AI assistant connect to query incidents, analyze alerts, check on-call, manage escalations, and run operational analysis, and a runtime probe confirms the hosted endpoint (mcp.incident.io/mcp) is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. This is strong first-party documentation plus independent runtime corroboration. Missing for 10: broader third-party/community hands-on reports of using the MCP server in production.
